title: ME41603: Vibration And Noise Control
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite âDesign of Machine ElementsFundamentals of Vibration Theory; Force
Transmissibility, Design of Vibration Isolators and Absorbers and other passive
dampers; Active Vibration control; Torsional Vibration; Basics of Acoustics,
Solution of 1-D and 3-D wave equation, Sound Field Characterization, Sound
Sources, Principles of Noise Control, Reflection and Transmission of Sound
Waves, Noise Control Materials: Absorbers, Barriers and Damping Materials,
Silencers.

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion

How to Crack the Paper

Classroom resources

A das gupta

It is super hard if you don't go to class. You need to regularly understand. 

Sir teaches quite well and is patient with doubts. So ask away. 

Actually understanding is optional if you can memorize/solve similar stuff to whatever is done in class. 

Everything in exam is from class notes only and only and only. So that's most important. 

You'll find it extremely difficult to find any online or any other resources. No need to do previous year papers. Just mug class notes thoroughly. 

Some fast calculation helps, but anirvan dasgupta sir is chill about it.
